zh.caseTitle: 案件：明星代言的「增肌蛋白粉」
zh.witnessName: 代言明星与公司发言人的证言
zh.testimony: 知名健身博主李某某在镜头前说：这款蛋白粉我每天喝，我的肌肉就是这么练出来的，强烈推荐给大家！公司发言人补充道：我们请了最专业的营养师团队参与研发，配方无可挑剔。至于这款产品最近销量下滑，纯属竞品恶意抹黑，请大家放心购买。

textRefs.spot_celebrity: 这款蛋白粉我每天喝，我的肌肉就是这么练出来的，强烈推荐给大家
textRefs.spot_noqual: 我们请了最专业的营养师团队参与研发，配方无可挑剔
textRefs.spot_sponsor: 销量下滑，纯属竞品恶意抹黑，请大家放心购买
textRefs.debunk_celebrity: 名人见证：明星的肌肉来自长期训练和营养师团队，不一定与这款蛋白粉有关——名人的「亲身推荐」不是产品有效性的证据。
textRefs.debunk_noqual: 资质存疑：「最专业的营养师团队」没有任何姓名、资质或可查证的信息——「我们请了专家」不等于「真有专家」。
textRefs.debunk_sponsor: 利益冲突：销量下滑时喊「竞品抹黑」，是利益相关方在为自己开脱——越卖力辩护，越要警惕。
textRefs.q_celebrity: 明星的肌肉，真的是这款蛋白粉的功劳吗？有没有其他因素？
textRefs.q_noqual: 「最专业的营养师团队」具体是谁？能提供资质和履历吗？
textRefs.q_sponsor: 销量下滑有没有更简单的解释，比如产品本身的问题？
textRefs.q_d1: 明星代言上线后，这款蛋白粉的销量提高了多少？
textRefs.q_d2: 营养师团队参与这支广告的时间有多长？

nearMissFeedback.q_d1: 销量上涨能说明代言有说服力，却不能区分产品效果、粉丝效应和广告投放。
nearMissFeedback.q_d2: 参与时间能说明投入程度，却不能证明营养师有资质、参与研发或保持独立。

hints: 名人代言 ≠ 产品有效——明星也是被雇来念稿的
「我们请了专家」——专家是谁？可查证吗？
利益相关方的「辟谣」，先打个问号
zh.explanation: 这则代言证词有三处破绽：名人体验不等于产品功效，「最专业团队」无法核验，公司又有直接利益。销量涨幅只能说明代言有说服力，参与广告多久也不能证明营养师独立或专业；相关信息不等于关键证据。

en.witnessName: Testimony of the Celebrity and the Company Spokesperson
en.testimony: Famous fitness blogger Li says on camera: I drink this protein powder every day, this is how I built my muscles, I strongly recommend it! A company spokesperson adds: we had the most professional team of nutritionists involved in development, the formula is beyond reproach. As for the recent sales decline, it is purely malicious smearing by competitors — buy with confidence.

textRefs.spot_celebrity: I drink this protein powder every day, this is how I built my muscles
textRefs.spot_noqual: we had the most professional team of nutritionists involved in development
textRefs.debunk_celebrity: Celebrity testimony: the star's muscles come from years of training and a team of nutritionists — not necessarily this powder. A celebrity's "personal recommendation" is not evidence of effectiveness.
textRefs.debunk_noqual: Questionable qualification: "the most professional team of nutritionists" has no names, credentials, or verifiable information — "we hired experts" is not "real experts exist".
textRefs.debunk_sponsor: Conflict of interest: blaming competitors when sales drop is an interested party defending itself — the harder it defends, the more you should watch out.
textRefs.q_celebrity: Are the celebrity's muscles really thanks to this powder? Could other factors be at play?
textRefs.q_noqual: Who exactly is "the most professional team of nutritionists"? Can you show credentials and track records?
textRefs.q_sponsor: Is there a simpler explanation for the sales decline, like a problem with the product itself?
textRefs.q_d1: How much did sales rise after the celebrity campaign launched?
textRefs.q_d2: How long did the nutritionist team work on this advertisement?

nearMissFeedback.q_d1: A sales lift shows persuasion, but cannot separate product efficacy from fandom or ad spending.
nearMissFeedback.q_d2: Time spent shows involvement, not that the nutritionists were qualified, worked on the formula, or remained independent.

hints: Celebrity endorsement ≠ effective product — stars are hired to read a script
"We hired experts" — who are they? Can you verify?
Put a question mark on any "rebuttal" from an interested party
en.explanation: This endorsement has three flaws: celebrity experience does not prove efficacy, the 'most professional team' cannot be verified, and the company has a direct interest. A sales lift measures persuasion, while time spent on the ad proves neither expertise nor independence. Related information is not necessarily decisive evidence.
